answer_sentences.text: No; the 3% pre-payment fee in the 2026-02-10 copy does not match the version in the provided sources that shows a 2% pre-payment charge for the same clause.
answer_sentences.quote: 3 Pre-payment charge 2% of principal outstanding On pre-payment or foreclosure

answer_sentences.text: The 2026-02-10 copy instead states a 3% charge on the principal outstanding for foreclosure or pre-payment.
answer_sentences.quote: In the event of foreclosure or pre-payment of the loan, in full or in part, the Borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding.
